{ "entries"    :  [] }{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name_han": "道德真經集註",
      "logic_thesis": "The text proves that the Dao cannot be fixed by any single school; truth is recovered only by lining up rival commentaries until their shared spine appears. Multi-author collation is itself a method of knowing: where Tang and Song readings converge, the argument of the Daodejing is strongest; where they diverge, the reader is forced to hold paradox rather than force a dogma.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the Daodejing is brief, polyvalent, and historically over-interpreted. 2) Premise: imperial, scholastic, and mystical notes each capture a partial facet of the same source. 3) Inference: collecting them without premature synthesis preserves the text’s productive ambiguity. 4) Inference: recurring motifs across houses (wuwei, ziran, return) mark non-contingent core claims. 5) Inference: outliers are diagnostic of later agendas, not of the root scripture. 6) Conclusion: authority rests in the comparative pattern of sagely speech, not in any one commentator’s monopoly.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When reading a BaZi chart, gather multiple classical rules (day-master strength, useful god, pattern, climate) before deciding; treat consensus of methods as higher than any single formula. 2) Map chart ‘paradoxes’ (e.g. strong yet cold structure) as intentional tension to hold, not errors to erase. 3) In cultivation, alternate intellectual study with silent sitting so commentary does not harden into opinion. 4) Keep a notebook of where schools agree on a stem-branch relation; those agreements become your working axioms. 5) Refuse ‘one true school’ marketing; use plurality as a filter against overconfident prediction.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike a single-author Daodejing note that argues one coherent metaphysics, this jizhu proves by anthological method: truth emerges from intersection, not from original genius. It differs from pure philological editions by treating later Song readings as living co-speakers rather than corruptions. The purpose is epistemic humility under the Dao, not dynastic orthodoxy."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "梓潼帝君化書",
      "logic_thesis": "The book proves that moral and literary authority in the human world is the visible residue of long multi-life divine pedagogy. Wenchang/Zitong’s successive transformations demonstrate that Heaven educates society through embodied careers of virtue, not through abstract decree alone. Destiny is thus a curriculum of incarnations that reward upright intent and punish literary fraud.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: a high stellar-literary deity repeatedly takes human form. 2) Premise: each incarnation stages a moral test (loyalty, filiality, honesty in exams, care for the dead). 3) Inference: human success or failure is a scene in a longer divine teaching drama. 4) Inference: official rank and literary fame are secondary effects of aligned will, not primary causes of worth. 5) Inference: unrepented wrongdoing persists across lives as debt until transformed. 6) Conclusion: cultivating character is the real mechanism of ‘fate change’ under Wenchang’s jurisdiction.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi work on exam, promotion, or fame stars (especially related to Wenqu/Wenchang symbolism), weigh ethics and study discipline above lucky combinations alone. 2) Treat career setbacks as curriculum scenes: ask which virtue is being trained, not only which star is harmed. 3) For clients seeking ‘name and rank,’ prescribe concrete upright practices (honest speech, teacher-respect, merit for students) as co-causes with chart timing. 4) Use multi-life debt language carefully: reframe as unfinished moral projects, not fatalism. 5) Align personal writing/teaching work with service, matching the deity’s literary-moral axis.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure technical almanacs or stem-branch manuals, this text argues through sacred biography rather than calculations. It differs from generic shenmo novels by claiming pedagogical continuity of one officer across lives. Its logic is hagiographic ethics: fate is educative narrative, not impersonal mechanism."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上玄靈北斗本命延生真經註",
      "logic_thesis": "The commentary proves that individual lifespan and fortune are administered through the Northern Dipper as a living bureaucracy of destiny, not as blind astrology. Because each person has a Benming affiliation under the Dipper, sincere ritual alignment, repentance, and stellar devotion can petition for extension and correction of life-script. Fate is thus addressable: cosmic officers respond to clarified intent and correct practice.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the Beidou stars oversee birth, death, fortune, and record of deeds. 2) Premise: each being is linked to a natal star-officer (benming). 3) Inference: misfortune often signals misalignment or unrepaired debt under that jurisdiction. 4) Inference: scripture recitation, confession, and offerings open a lawful channel to the same office that wrote the ledger. 5) Inference: ‘yan sheng’ (life extension) is not theft of Heaven but re-harmonization of the ledger. 6) Conclusion: destiny is bureaucratic-cosmic and therefore remediable through correct stellar-moral practice.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Locate the client’s Benming/Dipper correspondence (birth year/day traditions used in your lineage) and treat it as a relationship, not a static label. 2) Pair BaZi illness or longevity warnings with Dipper repentance, night-sky mindfulness, and ethical repair rather than amulets alone. 3) In annual luck reading, note years that clash with natal Dipper themes and increase stillness, charity, and sleep hygiene as ‘petition body.’ 4) Teach that begging for years without changing conduct fails the bureaucratic logic of the text. 5) Use the Dipper’s sevenfold structure as a model for sequential self-audit (will, speech, desire, etc.).",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike pure neidan longevity texts that internalize stars as body gods only, this register stresses external stellar officers and petition. It differs from cold fate-calculation manuals by adding responsive bureaucracy: the same Dipper that decrees also hears. The proof strategy is ritual-theological, not mathematical."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黃帝陰符經註",
      "logic_thesis": "This single-thread commentary proves that human mastery arises from stealthy correspondence with the hidden mechanisms of Heaven and Earth—‘yin fu’ as secret tally—not from open force. Knowing the killing and generating pivots of cosmos allows the sage to act at the joint of change with minimal expenditure. The argument is epistemic-strategic: insight into mechanism replaces brute will.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Heaven and Earth operate by concealed regularities of birth and kill. 2) Premise: the human body-mind is a micro-instance of those same regularities. 3) Inference: to ‘steal the mechanism’ is to perceive timing and leverage, not to violate Dao. 4) Inference: rash action against the grain multiplies friction; action with the joint multiplies effect. 5) Inference: clarity of observation is the true weapon. 6) Conclusion: victory in life and cultivation is synchronization with hidden law.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, prioritize ‘ji’ (mechanism): useful god as leverage point rather than collecting many favorable gods. 2) Time interventions (career moves, medical change, retreats) to chart joints (month/day transitions, void-clash resolutions). 3) Practice daily observation of breath, mood, and environment as training in reading hidden tallies. 4) Reduce forced effort in daoyun years that lack support; store force for high-leverage windows. 5) Treat enemies and obstacles as expressions of mechanism to be redirected, not merely smashed.",
      "logic_compare": "Compared with collected multi-sage Yinfu editions, a solo zhu presses one coherent reading of ‘stealing the mechanism.’ It is less encyclopedic than jizhu/jijie and more like a strategic monologue. Relative to later pure neidan Yinfu notes, it still keeps cosmological-strategic breadth rather than only furnace allegory."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黃帝陰符經集註",
      "logic_thesis": "The seven-house collected note proves that the Yinfu Jing is a portable matrix of sagely statecraft and tactical intelligence, legible to ministers, strategists, and recluses alike. By stacking voices attributed to ancient counselors, it shows the text’s claims survive translation across political, military, and personal domains. The core proof: one law of timing and human nature scales from empire to self.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: multiple legendary strategists can annotate the same short classic productively. 2) Premise: their domains (governance, war, diplomacy, personal survival) differ in surface. 3) Inference: shared annotations imply a domain-invariant logic of opportunity and human desire. 4) Inference: ‘human as the universe’s thief’ is a thesis about lawful appropriation of timing, not criminality. 5) Inference: diversity of notes is evidence of generality, not of confusion. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu is a cross-domain operating system of mechanism, validated by polymathic reception.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Read a BaZi career chart as both battlefield and court: allies, resources, and timing windows as strategic terrain. 2) When models conflict (official star vs wealth star vs print), use multi-domain analogy: which ‘campaign’ is this decade? 3) Train clients to spot recurring desire-traps (overextension at peak) as Yinfu’s warning on human nature. 4) Use polyglot method: test a judgment with at least two classical frames before advising action. 5) In cultivation, treat political metaphors as maps for inner factions (will, appetite, fear).",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike a single neidan or single Confucian note, jizhu proves by multi-role consensus that the classic is strategically universal. It differs from Yuan Shuzhen’s jijie by privileging legendary counselor voices over systematic scholastic unbinding. Its identity is anthological statecraft, not pure metaphysics."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黃帝陰符經集解",
      "logic_thesis": "Yuan Shuzhen’s collected exposition proves that the Yinfu’s dark aphorisms unfold into a coherent theory of heaven-human co-transformation and cultivable mechanism. ‘Jijie’ means untying knots: each cryptic line is shown to imply yin-yang dynamics, mind regulation, and optional neidan refinement. The argument is that obscurity is pedagogical compression, not absence of system.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the root text is short and deliberately cryptic. 2) Premise: cryptic form stores multi-layer instruction for different grades of readers. 3) Inference: systematic unbinding recovers cosmology, ethics, and cultivation as one chain. 4) Inference: knowing without refining is incomplete; refining without knowing is blind. 5) Inference: heaven’s kill-birth rhythm is the same pattern as mind’s agitation and stillness. 6) Conclusion: true ‘knowledge of the mechanism’ culminates in ordered self-refinement aligned with cosmic process.",
      "logic_practice": "1) After any BaZi technical conclusion, write a one-sentence ‘mechanism’ statement (what is generating/killing what). 2) Translate that mechanism into one mind practice (e.g. if fire overacts, cool speech and reduce night stimulation). 3) Sequence study → body regulation → ethical restraint as the jijie’s implied ladder. 4) Use difficult chart configurations as ‘knots’ to untie slowly across luck cycles, not one-shot fixes. 5) Journal aphorism → application → result to reenact the text’s unbinding method.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike the seven-sage jizhu’s strategic polyphony, Yuan’s jijie aims at systematic philosophical-cultivational exposition. It differs from brief single zhu by insisting every line can be expanded into a teachable chain. Relative to purely martial readings, it recenters co-transformation and xiu lian."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "黃帝陰符經註",
      "logic_thesis": "This second independent Yinfu note proves a tighter cultivation reading: the ‘mechanism’ is primarily the mind’s power to invert disaster and fortune by seizing the hinge of desire, breath, and awareness. Where other notes expand outward to war and state, this line of zhu internalizes the battlefield. Proof object: autonomy of the refined mind within cosmic law.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: external mechanisms are endless and cannot all be controlled. 2) Premise: the mind is the nearest and most decisive mechanism. 3) Inference: mastering attention and desire is the efficient path of ‘stealing the machine.’ 4) Inference: emotional leakage is self-killing; gathered spirit is self-generating. 5) Inference: outer success becomes a side-effect of inner tally alignment. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu’s highest use is interior sovereignty under Heaven’s pattern.",
      "logic_practice": "1) For charts full of conflict (clash, punishment, harm), prioritize mind-hinge training over constant external remedy shopping. 2) Define one ‘hinge habit’ per decade (breath length, speech restraint, sleep gate) as your personal yin-fu. 3) At luck-pillar turns, do a three-day silent audit of desire spikes before making major moves. 4) Use BaZi warnings as triggers for inward gathering, not only as fear scripts. 5) Measure practice by reduced reactivity latency, not by mystical imagery.",
      "logic_compare": "Distinct from jizhu’s multi-strategist statecraft and from jijie’s full scholastic unbinding, this zhu compresses toward mind-cultivation efficacy. It differs from Dipper petition texts by locating remediation inside awareness rather than stellar bureaucracy. Same root classic, different proof: interior hinge versus outer tally offices."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君說常清靜經註",
      "logic_thesis": "This commentary proves that clarity (qing) and stillness (jing) are not moods but the operational nature of Dao as it appears in the human mind. Restlessness and turbidity are secondary waves; when the mind returns to constant clarity-stillness, names, desires, and cosmic order re-sort themselves. The argument is ontological-psychological: original mind is already Dao-like when not stirred.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Dao is constantly clear and still. 2) Premise: human spirit is of Dao-nature yet agitated by desire and discrimination. 3) Inference: practice is subtraction of agitation, not acquisition of a foreign purity. 4) Inference: when mind stills, perception clears; when perception clears, action becomes non-forcing. 5) Inference: social and bodily disorders often trace to turbid mind rather than mere outer bad luck. 6) Conclusion: constant qing-jing is both realization and method.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Before chart analysis, take 3–5 minutes of breath-settling so the reader’s turbidity does not project into the BaZi. 2) Prescribe daily ‘clear-still’ micro-sessions timed to the client’s peak agitation hour. 3) Map heavy water/muddiness or scattered fire in charts to concrete turbidity patterns (rumination vs overstimulation). 4) Use ‘constant’ as KPI: short frequent returns beat rare deep retreats for lay practitioners. 5) Link ethical speech to stillness: fewer reactive words conserve spirit.",
      "logic_compare": "Relative to Yinfu’s emphasis on seizing mechanism, Qingjing proves by releasing mechanism-chasing itself. Unlike elaborate neidan diagram books, this note’s logic is austere: return, don’t construct. It is closer to Laozi’s core than to later furnace taxonomy."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君說常清靜經註",
      "logic_thesis": "A second classical note-line proves that clarity and stillness function as a two-stroke engine: stillness gathers, clarity illumines, and their oscillation refines the heart into non-dwelling awareness. It argues against one-sided quietism and one-sided intellectual brightness. The proof is methodological: paired cultivation prevents dead emptiness and dry cleverness.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: stillness without clarity becomes dull void. 2) Premise: clarity without stillness becomes sharp scattered knowing. 3) Inference: the scripture’s binomial is a technical pair, not poetic synonym. 4) Inference: practice must alternate or co-arise gather and illuminate. 5) Inference: afflictions dissolve when seen clearly inside a stable field. 6) Conclusion: balanced qing-jing is the reliable path of mind realization for householders and adepts.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Design sessions as 2 phases: settle (jing) then open awareness without commentary (qing). 2) For metal-dry or fire-scatter chart types, weight more jing first; for water-stagnant types, introduce gentle qing earlier. 3) In decision-making, forbid analysis until body stills (pulse, breath). 4) Use walking or simple chore as ‘moving stillness’ to avoid cushion dependency. 5) Track weekly whether you leaned dull or scattered, and rebalance.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike a purely ontological reading that equates qing=jing as one essence, this line proves their complementary functions. It differs from ritual purity codes by locating purity in cognitive-affective dynamics. Against neidan’s multi-stage maps, it keeps a minimal dual method."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "太上老君說常清靜經註",
      "logic_thesis": "A third commentarial trajectory proves social-ethical and cosmological extension: a clear-still person becomes a non-disturbing node in family, state, and world, so personal cultivation is already political-ecological care. Turbid mind multiplies conflict cycles; constant clarity-stillness reduces collective friction. The argument binds self-cultivation to order without Confucian moralizing externalism alone.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: mind states radiate into speech, role performance, and group field. 2) Premise: the classic ties human clarity-stillness to Heaven-Earth’s calm regularity. 3) Inference: private agitation is a public risk factor. 4) Inference: governing self is the root technology of governing circumstances. 5) Inference: fate ‘softens’ around a person who stops feeding turbulence. 6) Conclusion: Qingjing practice is a civilizational micro-virtue with cosmic analogy.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In relationship BaZi (spouse palace, mutual charts), treat shared turbidity as the first problem before blaming star clashes. 2) Prescribe household quiet hours and speech covenants as applied qing-jing. 3) For leaders, convert ‘stillness’ into fewer panic policy swings during clash years. 4) Use charity and fair dealing as extensions of clarity (not bribes to gods). 5) Evaluate practice by decrease of drama frequency in close networks.",
      "logic_compare": "Distinct from purely meditative notes, this trajectory proves outward field effects of qing-jing. It differs from Golden Register public liturgy by starting from mind rather than altar protocol. Compared with Wenchang moral biography, it is less narrative-karmic and more present-tense field hygiene."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "金籙大齋啟盟儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The opening-covenant rite proves that large-scale retreat efficacy begins with a binding oath that aligns community will, priestly office, and Heaven’s registers before any petition is filed. Without sealed alliance (qi meng), later offerings lack jurisdictional standing. Ritual success is therefore contractual-cosmic, not merely aesthetic performance.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Golden Register retreats address high celestial ledgers for salvation and protection. 2) Premise: Heaven’s offices respond to authorized, sincere, and correctly ranked requests. 3) Inference: the opening covenant establishes legal-spiritual standing for the assembly. 4) Inference: shared oath unifies scattered private wishes into one lawful intention. 5) Inference: violation of covenant voids or weakens subsequent ritual credit. 6) Conclusion: alliance is the logical precondition of retreat power.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Before a multi-day personal cultivation retreat, write and read aloud a clear covenant (scope, duration, precepts). 2) In BaZi ‘remedy’ work, refuse vague multi-wishes; form one ranked intention as your meng. 3) Include accountability (witness, journal, teacher) to mimic communal oath pressure. 4) Start programs with purification and consent, not with advanced visualizations. 5) If the covenant breaks, repair formally before restarting techniques.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike private neidan manuals that begin with body maps, this text proves public juridical entry conditions. It differs from ordinary jiao setup by focusing specifically on the opening alliance moment. Compared with Qingjing’s interior purity, here purity is sworn, collective, and procedural."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "金籙設醮儀",
      "logic_thesis": "The jiao-establishment liturgy proves that cosmic disorder and communal risk are renegotiated through a structured banquet-audience with deities, where offerings, positions, and sequences enact a restored hierarchy. ‘She jiao’ is not entertainment; it is diplomatic protocol with Heaven. Order returns when human side correctly hosts the divine guest-order.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: imbalance in seasons, health, or polity signals broken reciprocity with higher powers. 2) Premise: deities receive hospitality and testimony in ranked ritual space. 3) Inference: correct seating, offerings, texts, and timing make the human side legible and respectful. 4) Inference: once audience is granted, confessions and petitions can be entered into the register. 5) Inference: closing and sending-off prevent lingering imbalance from incomplete diplomacy. 6) Conclusion: structured hospitality is a technology of re-harmonization.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Treat major luck-cycle transitions like setting a jiao: prepare space, offerings (gratitude acts), clear petition, and formal close. 2) Sequence BaZi advice as protocol: first acknowledge costs/debts, then ask, then commit conduct. 3) Use seasonal festivals as natural jiao nodes rather than random crisis only. 4) Avoid ‘buy luck’ transactions without reciprocal virtue—protocol without sincerity fails. 5) After any big ritual or life move, perform a conscious send-off (thanksgiving, cleanup, rest).",
      "logic_compare": "Where the Opening Covenant establishes standing, She Jiao proves the main diplomatic audience itself. It differs from personal stillness practice by being overtly hierarchical and material (altar, offerings). Unlike narrative miracle tales, its proof is procedural correctness under Golden Register rank."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "洞玄靈寶玉籙簡文三元威儀自然真經",
      "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that true ritual authority is ‘natural demeanor’ (ziran weiyi): bodily bearing, sequence, and script that spontaneously mirror the Three Primes’ cosmic hierarchy. Lingbao salvation technology works when human movement becomes isomorphic with heaven’s own order. Form is not empty shell; form is condensed cosmos.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the Three Primes structure time, judgment, and salvation registers. 2) Premise: Lingbao rites claim to operate those registers for universal deliverance. 3) Inference: without precise natural deportment, the human body fails to match the register’s ‘interface.’ 4) Inference: written jade instructions fix the interface so transmission does not drift. 5) Inference: ‘natural’ means according to Dao’s order, not casual improvisation. 6) Conclusion: perfected etiquette is soteriological engineering.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Standardize your reading posture, breath, and desk layout as ‘weiyi’ for every BaZi consultation—form stabilizes mind. 2) Learn one complete ceremonial sequence in life (tea, bow, offering) to train body as orderly instrument. 3) Align annual three-yuan / three-prime seasonal audits with confession and reset. 4) Prefer transmitted forms over DIY occult mashups when stakes are high. 5) Correct sloppy daily etiquette (doors, greetings, meals) as micro-Lingbao training.",
      "logic_compare": "Distinct from Golden Register’s specific retreat and jiao dossiers, this text proves the general principle that natural cosmic etiquette is itself the true scripture. It differs from neidan diagrams by externalizing order into visible deportment. Compared with Qingjing, it externalizes purity into choreography rather than only mind."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "皇經集註",
      "logic_thesis": "Collected commentary on the Jade Emperor scripture proves that ultimate moral-salvific sovereignty is centralized in a celestial imperial court whose decrees organize all lesser offices, gods, and human fates. Multi-note collation shows the Huangjing as constitution of the sacred empire rather than a private meditation pamphlet. The argument: loyalty, repentance, and recitation plug the person into the highest lawful source of pardon and protection.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: the Jade Emperor stands at the apex of the popular-Daoist celestial bureaucracy. 2) Premise: the root scripture narrates and enacts that sovereignty. 3) Inference: commentaries from multiple hands recover doctrinal, ritual, and ethical layers of that constitution. 4) Inference: human misfortune is often a lower-office problem that still answers to highest court. 5) Inference: sincere recitation is a petition technology under imperial law, not magic independence. 6) Conclusion: aligning with the August Writ reorders subordinate fate mechanisms.",
      "logic_practice": "1) When charts show stacked authority stars or severe official-kill patterns, interpret through ‘court hierarchy’: which level of life law is active? 2) Use confession + high-level dedication (service, honesty under power) as parallel to Huangjing repentance. 3) For protection cases, combine practical legal/ethical cleanup with spiritual petition—same as addressing the apex court after fixing lower faults. 4) Study one chapter with multiple notes to avoid single-sect slogans. 5) Cultivate respectful speech about rulers, teachers, and parents as training in celestial hierarchy literacy.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Dipper Benming texts that emphasize stellar natal officers, Huangjing jizhu centers apex imperial sovereignty. It differs from Yinfu’s secret mechanism by stressing public sacred law and pardon. Relative to local earth-god or Taishan cults, it argues top-down constitutional order."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "元始天尊說東嶽化身濟生度死拔罪解冤保命玄範誥呪妙經",
      "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that life, death, sin, grievance, and lifespan fall under East Peak (Taishan) jurisdiction, and that Yuanshi’s revealed forms, proclamations, and spells authorize lawful intervention in that underworld-administrative complex. Salvation is not vague compassion only; it is procedural release across specific case types (guilt, feud, premature death). Proof object: specialized eschatological bureaucracy can be petitioned through revealed templates.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: East Peak administers registers of the dead and many living debts. 2) Premise: grievances and sins bind lifespan and rebirth trajectories. 3) Inference: without authority from a higher revealer (Yuanshi), local petition may lack force. 4) Inference: categorized aims (ji sheng, du si, ba zui, jie yuan, bao ming) require matching formulaic speech-acts. 5) Inference: incarnation language (‘huashen’) shows the Peak’s power can take accessible forms for aid. 6) Conclusion: structured gao-zhou practice is legal medicine for fate-knots of guilt and feud.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Separate client problems into the text’s categories: living crisis, death rites, guilt, interpersonal curse-like feud, pure longevity. 2) For chart patterns of empty luck + chronic conflict, investigate unresolved grievances (family, business) as jie-yuan work. 3) Combine apology/restitution in the human world with any liturgical petition—bureaucracy checks both. 4) Use memorial days and Qingming-type nodes as natural East Peak calendrical openings. 5) Avoid generic ‘bless me’ requests; file the correct case type.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike Qingjing’s mind purification or Yinfu’s strategy, this text proves underworld-administrative soteriology. It differs from Wenchang’s literary-moral curriculum by focusing death, sin, and feud ledgers. Relative to Golden Register high retreats, it is more specialized to Taishan’s docket."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "搜神記",
      "logic_thesis": "Gan Bao’s collection proves the reality and moral intelligibility of the spirit world by cumulative case evidence: anomalies, ghosts, and divine responses recur with pattern under Heaven’s order. The logic is proto-empirical and historiographic rather than purely revelatory: many witnessed irregularities jointly refute a closed material cosmos. Spirits enforce ethics and answer sincerity across scattered locales.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: singular marvels can be dismissed as error or fraud. 2) Premise: carefully recorded multi-region cases show repeated structure (wrongdoing punished, virtue answered, boundaries between living/dead). 3) Inference: the numinous is a stable layer of the world, not random noise. 4) Inference: human virtue and vice have cross-realm consequences. 5) Inference: historiography of anomalies is a legitimate knowing method for Dao-adjacent culture. 6) Conclusion: moral-cosmic order includes spirit agency as a fact to live with.",
      "logic_practice": "1) In counseling, treat ‘weird’ life strings as data requiring pattern-finding, not automatic superstition or automatic denial. 2) Build a personal case log of timing + event + ethical context analogous to Soushen method. 3) Use stories pedagogically to teach consequences without fabricating guarantees. 4) When BaZi coincides with classic ghost-feud motifs (sudden night illness, repeated similar accidents), add grievance-audit before more metal-water technical tweaks. 5) Cultivate careful speech about the dead; the text’s world is porous.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike revealed Lingbao codes, Soushenji proves by anecdotal aggregation, not altar transmission. It differs from systematic neidan atlases by offering no cultivation ladder—only a haunted moral cosmos. Relative to imperial Huangjing theology, it is bottom-up folklore-as-evidence rather than top-down constitution."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "修真太極混元圖",
      "logic_thesis": "The diagram corpus proves that Taiji-Hunyuan cultivation can be made cartographic: stages of yin-yang ascent/descent, three powers, and embryo-breathing are real transitions that images can fix better than prose alone. If the path is mappable, it is teachable and error-checkable. Proof object: visual isomorphism between cosmos and body process.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: mixed original qi differentiates into ordered polarities and returns. 2) Premise: the adept’s body reenacts that cosmogony in reverse and forward. 3) Inference: diagrams of three scenes, three powers, sun-moon phases, etc., are operational maps, not ornaments. 4) Inference: sequence errors in practice equal navigation errors on the map. 5) Inference: seeing the whole atlas prevents partial technique addiction. 6) Conclusion: image-logic is a valid epistemic tool for neidan transmission.",
      "logic_practice": "1) Draw your current practice location on a simple Taiji-Hunyuan sketch monthly—locate yourself. 2) Match BaZi climate (cold/hot, dry/wet) to which diagram phase needs support. 3) Use moon-phase diagrams to schedule quieter gathering vs circulating days. 4) Teach beginners with one image before vocabulary overload. 5) When stuck, return to earlier map node rather than adding exotic methods.",
      "logic_compare": "Unlike purely textual Qingjing notes, this work proves by graphic systemization. It is more cosmogonic-overview than the more ‘pointing to mystery’ sequel, and less commercially sequential than Jinye Huandan ‘seal verification’ sets. Relative to ritual weiyi scriptures, its map is interior cosmography."
    },
    {
      "name_han": "修真太極混元指玄圖",
      "logic_thesis": "This ‘pointing-to-the-mysterious’ atlas proves that beyond public Taiji-Hunyuan outlines there exists a tighter esoteric indexing of key orifices, timings, and transformations that must be indicated, not merely displayed. The logic is hierarchical pedagogy: same cosmos, deeper legend keys. Diagrams here function as pointers that unlock oral or meditative secrecy.",
      "logic_chain": "1) Premise: outer diagrams can be copied without realization. 2) Premise: the mysterious hinge (xuan) is few and easy to miss. 3) Inference: a second graphic layer must mark the hinges explicitly for the prepared. 4) Inference: ‘zhi xuan’ is selective illumination, not total disclosure to the unready. 5) Inference: body-cosmos correspondences tighten around specific operations (refine form, conjoin water-fire, etc.). 6) Conclusion: true transmission is map + pointed hinge + practice confirmation.",
      "logic_practice": "1) After learning a public map, isolate one hinge (e.g. true breathing pivot) for 100-day focus. 2) Keep a private legend key—personal notes of what each symbol actually did in experience. 3) Do not teach advanced pointers to those without stillness basics (Qingjing precondition). 4) Use BaZi structure to choose which hinge is safer (e.g. weak body vs strong body strategies). 5) Verify pointers by bodily signs and life stability, not by collecting more images.",

It differs from Jinye’s stage-seal marketing of results by stressing mystery-hinges. Against purely philosophical Laozi notes, it remains operative and somatic."

The argument is anti-fraud and anti-skipping: alchemy is a chain of evidence in the body-mind, not belief in ornate language. Golden liquid returning is a lawlike process that signs itself.",

      "logic_practice": "1) Define 3–5 pre-agreed verification signs for your current stage (sleep quality, emotional latency, thermal balance, ethical stability). 2) Refuse stage promotion based on internet symptoms alone; require time-stamped personal seals. 3) Align intense refining with supportive luck pillars; in weak years, hold and consolidate. 4) Treat speech about attainments as a leak that breaks seals. 5) Pair any advanced claim with increased ordinary virtue—moral regression invalidates ‘proof.’",

Relative to pure ritual pardon scriptures, it does not primarily clear external ledgers—it verifies somatic-cosmic reintegration."

Experience is the editor of theory: only maps that survive practice deserve circulation. The argument is empiricist within the neidan tradition.",

      "logic_practice": "1) Build your own one-page ‘verified only’ chart of methods that changed measurable life/body variables. 2) Delete or quarantine techniques that never sealed after fair trial. 3) When studying classical images, ask: what experience could have forced this drawing? 4) In BaZi advising, prefer remedies with track records in similar structures over exotic new systems. 5) End each season with a liyan review: keep, drop, rework.",

It differs from Jinye’s stage-seal idealism by emphasizing copied, field-tested schemata as a corpus. entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the Dao cannot be fixed by any single school; truth is recovered only by lining up rival commentaries until their shared spine appears. Multi-author collation is itself a method of knowing: where Tang and Song readings converge, the argument of the Daodejing is strongest; where they diverge, the reader is forced to hold paradox rather than force a dogma.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the Daodejing is brief, polyvalent, and historically over-interpreted. 2) Premise: imperial, scholastic, and mystical notes each capture a partial facet of the same source. 3) Inference: collecting them without premature synthesis preserves the text’s productive ambiguity. 4) Inference: recurring motifs across houses (wuwei, ziran, return) mark non-contingent core claims. 5) Inference: outliers are diagnostic of later agendas, not of the root scripture. 6) Conclusion: authority rests in the comparative pattern of sagely speech, not in any one commentator’s monopoly.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When reading a BaZi chart, gather multiple classical rules (day-master strength, useful god, pattern, climate) before deciding; treat consensus of methods as higher than any single formula. 2) Map chart ‘paradoxes’ (e.g. strong yet cold structure) as intentional tension to hold, not errors to erase. 3) In cultivation, alternate intellectual study with silent sitting so commentary does not harden into opinion. 4) Keep a notebook of where schools agree on a stem-branch relation; those agreements become your working axioms. 5) Refuse ‘one true school’ marketing; use plurality as a filter against overconfident prediction.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike a single-author Daodejing note that argues one coherent metaphysics, this jizhu proves by anthological method: truth emerges from intersection, not from original genius. It differs from pure philological editions by treating later Song readings as living co-speakers rather than corruptions. The purpose is epistemic humility under the Dao, not dynastic orthodoxy.

entries.logic_thesis: The book proves that moral and literary authority in the human world is the visible residue of long multi-life divine pedagogy. Wenchang/Zitong’s successive transformations demonstrate that Heaven educates society through embodied careers of virtue, not through abstract decree alone. Destiny is thus a curriculum of incarnations that reward upright intent and punish literary fraud.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: a high stellar-literary deity repeatedly takes human form. 2) Premise: each incarnation stages a moral test (loyalty, filiality, honesty in exams, care for the dead). 3) Inference: human success or failure is a scene in a longer divine teaching drama. 4) Inference: official rank and literary fame are secondary effects of aligned will, not primary causes of worth. 5) Inference: unrepented wrongdoing persists across lives as debt until transformed. 6) Conclusion: cultivating character is the real mechanism of ‘fate change’ under Wenchang’s jurisdiction.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi work on exam, promotion, or fame stars (especially related to Wenqu/Wenchang symbolism), weigh ethics and study discipline above lucky combinations alone. 2) Treat career setbacks as curriculum scenes: ask which virtue is being trained, not only which star is harmed. 3) For clients seeking ‘name and rank,’ prescribe concrete upright practices (honest speech, teacher-respect, merit for students) as co-causes with chart timing. 4) Use multi-life debt language carefully: reframe as unfinished moral projects, not fatalism. 5) Align personal writing/teaching work with service, matching the deity’s literary-moral axis.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure technical almanacs or stem-branch manuals, this text argues through sacred biography rather than calculations. It differs from generic shenmo novels by claiming pedagogical continuity of one officer across lives. Its logic is hagiographic ethics: fate is educative narrative, not impersonal mechanism.

entries.name_han: 太上玄靈北斗本命延生真經註
entries.logic_thesis: The commentary proves that individual lifespan and fortune are administered through the Northern Dipper as a living bureaucracy of destiny, not as blind astrology. Because each person has a Benming affiliation under the Dipper, sincere ritual alignment, repentance, and stellar devotion can petition for extension and correction of life-script. Fate is thus addressable: cosmic officers respond to clarified intent and correct practice.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the Beidou stars oversee birth, death, fortune, and record of deeds. 2) Premise: each being is linked to a natal star-officer (benming). 3) Inference: misfortune often signals misalignment or unrepaired debt under that jurisdiction. 4) Inference: scripture recitation, confession, and offerings open a lawful channel to the same office that wrote the ledger. 5) Inference: ‘yan sheng’ (life extension) is not theft of Heaven but re-harmonization of the ledger. 6) Conclusion: destiny is bureaucratic-cosmic and therefore remediable through correct stellar-moral practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Locate the client’s Benming/Dipper correspondence (birth year/day traditions used in your lineage) and treat it as a relationship, not a static label. 2) Pair BaZi illness or longevity warnings with Dipper repentance, night-sky mindfulness, and ethical repair rather than amulets alone. 3) In annual luck reading, note years that clash with natal Dipper themes and increase stillness, charity, and sleep hygiene as ‘petition body.’ 4) Teach that begging for years without changing conduct fails the bureaucratic logic of the text. 5) Use the Dipper’s sevenfold structure as a model for sequential self-audit (will, speech, desire, etc.).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure neidan longevity texts that internalize stars as body gods only, this register stresses external stellar officers and petition. It differs from cold fate-calculation manuals by adding responsive bureaucracy: the same Dipper that decrees also hears. The proof strategy is ritual-theological, not mathematical.

entries.logic_thesis: This single-thread commentary proves that human mastery arises from stealthy correspondence with the hidden mechanisms of Heaven and Earth—‘yin fu’ as secret tally—not from open force. Knowing the killing and generating pivots of cosmos allows the sage to act at the joint of change with minimal expenditure. The argument is epistemic-strategic: insight into mechanism replaces brute will.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Heaven and Earth operate by concealed regularities of birth and kill. 2) Premise: the human body-mind is a micro-instance of those same regularities. 3) Inference: to ‘steal the mechanism’ is to perceive timing and leverage, not to violate Dao. 4) Inference: rash action against the grain multiplies friction; action with the joint multiplies effect. 5) Inference: clarity of observation is the true weapon. 6) Conclusion: victory in life and cultivation is synchronization with hidden law.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, prioritize ‘ji’ (mechanism): useful god as leverage point rather than collecting many favorable gods. 2) Time interventions (career moves, medical change, retreats) to chart joints (month/day transitions, void-clash resolutions). 3) Practice daily observation of breath, mood, and environment as training in reading hidden tallies. 4) Reduce forced effort in daoyun years that lack support; store force for high-leverage windows. 5) Treat enemies and obstacles as expressions of mechanism to be redirected, not merely smashed.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with collected multi-sage Yinfu editions, a solo zhu presses one coherent reading of ‘stealing the mechanism.’ It is less encyclopedic than jizhu/jijie and more like a strategic monologue. Relative to later pure neidan Yinfu notes, it still keeps cosmological-strategic breadth rather than only furnace allegory.

entries.logic_thesis: The seven-house collected note proves that the Yinfu Jing is a portable matrix of sagely statecraft and tactical intelligence, legible to ministers, strategists, and recluses alike. By stacking voices attributed to ancient counselors, it shows the text’s claims survive translation across political, military, and personal domains. The core proof: one law of timing and human nature scales from empire to self.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: multiple legendary strategists can annotate the same short classic productively. 2) Premise: their domains (governance, war, diplomacy, personal survival) differ in surface. 3) Inference: shared annotations imply a domain-invariant logic of opportunity and human desire. 4) Inference: ‘human as the universe’s thief’ is a thesis about lawful appropriation of timing, not criminality. 5) Inference: diversity of notes is evidence of generality, not of confusion. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu is a cross-domain operating system of mechanism, validated by polymathic reception.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read a BaZi career chart as both battlefield and court: allies, resources, and timing windows as strategic terrain. 2) When models conflict (official star vs wealth star vs print), use multi-domain analogy: which ‘campaign’ is this decade? 3) Train clients to spot recurring desire-traps (overextension at peak) as Yinfu’s warning on human nature. 4) Use polyglot method: test a judgment with at least two classical frames before advising action. 5) In cultivation, treat political metaphors as maps for inner factions (will, appetite, fear).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike a single neidan or single Confucian note, jizhu proves by multi-role consensus that the classic is strategically universal. It differs from Yuan Shuzhen’s jijie by privileging legendary counselor voices over systematic scholastic unbinding. Its identity is anthological statecraft, not pure metaphysics.

entries.logic_thesis: Yuan Shuzhen’s collected exposition proves that the Yinfu’s dark aphorisms unfold into a coherent theory of heaven-human co-transformation and cultivable mechanism. ‘Jijie’ means untying knots: each cryptic line is shown to imply yin-yang dynamics, mind regulation, and optional neidan refinement. The argument is that obscurity is pedagogical compression, not absence of system.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the root text is short and deliberately cryptic. 2) Premise: cryptic form stores multi-layer instruction for different grades of readers. 3) Inference: systematic unbinding recovers cosmology, ethics, and cultivation as one chain. 4) Inference: knowing without refining is incomplete; refining without knowing is blind. 5) Inference: heaven’s kill-birth rhythm is the same pattern as mind’s agitation and stillness. 6) Conclusion: true ‘knowledge of the mechanism’ culminates in ordered self-refinement aligned with cosmic process.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After any BaZi technical conclusion, write a one-sentence ‘mechanism’ statement (what is generating/killing what). 2) Translate that mechanism into one mind practice (e.g. if fire overacts, cool speech and reduce night stimulation). 3) Sequence study → body regulation → ethical restraint as the jijie’s implied ladder. 4) Use difficult chart configurations as ‘knots’ to untie slowly across luck cycles, not one-shot fixes. 5) Journal aphorism → application → result to reenact the text’s unbinding method.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike the seven-sage jizhu’s strategic polyphony, Yuan’s jijie aims at systematic philosophical-cultivational exposition. It differs from brief single zhu by insisting every line can be expanded into a teachable chain. Relative to purely martial readings, it recenters co-transformation and xiu lian.

entries.logic_thesis: This second independent Yinfu note proves a tighter cultivation reading: the ‘mechanism’ is primarily the mind’s power to invert disaster and fortune by seizing the hinge of desire, breath, and awareness. Where other notes expand outward to war and state, this line of zhu internalizes the battlefield. Proof object: autonomy of the refined mind within cosmic law.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: external mechanisms are endless and cannot all be controlled. 2) Premise: the mind is the nearest and most decisive mechanism. 3) Inference: mastering attention and desire is the efficient path of ‘stealing the machine.’ 4) Inference: emotional leakage is self-killing; gathered spirit is self-generating. 5) Inference: outer success becomes a side-effect of inner tally alignment. 6) Conclusion: Yinfu’s highest use is interior sovereignty under Heaven’s pattern.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For charts full of conflict (clash, punishment, harm), prioritize mind-hinge training over constant external remedy shopping. 2) Define one ‘hinge habit’ per decade (breath length, speech restraint, sleep gate) as your personal yin-fu. 3) At luck-pillar turns, do a three-day silent audit of desire spikes before making major moves. 4) Use BaZi warnings as triggers for inward gathering, not only as fear scripts. 5) Measure practice by reduced reactivity latency, not by mystical imagery.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from jizhu’s multi-strategist statecraft and from jijie’s full scholastic unbinding, this zhu compresses toward mind-cultivation efficacy. It differs from Dipper petition texts by locating remediation inside awareness rather than stellar bureaucracy. Same root classic, different proof: interior hinge versus outer tally offices.

entries.name_han: 太上老君說常清靜經註
entries.logic_thesis: This commentary proves that clarity (qing) and stillness (jing) are not moods but the operational nature of Dao as it appears in the human mind. Restlessness and turbidity are secondary waves; when the mind returns to constant clarity-stillness, names, desires, and cosmic order re-sort themselves. The argument is ontological-psychological: original mind is already Dao-like when not stirred.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Dao is constantly clear and still. 2) Premise: human spirit is of Dao-nature yet agitated by desire and discrimination. 3) Inference: practice is subtraction of agitation, not acquisition of a foreign purity. 4) Inference: when mind stills, perception clears; when perception clears, action becomes non-forcing. 5) Inference: social and bodily disorders often trace to turbid mind rather than mere outer bad luck. 6) Conclusion: constant qing-jing is both realization and method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before chart analysis, take 3–5 minutes of breath-settling so the reader’s turbidity does not project into the BaZi. 2) Prescribe daily ‘clear-still’ micro-sessions timed to the client’s peak agitation hour. 3) Map heavy water/muddiness or scattered fire in charts to concrete turbidity patterns (rumination vs overstimulation). 4) Use ‘constant’ as KPI: short frequent returns beat rare deep retreats for lay practitioners. 5) Link ethical speech to stillness: fewer reactive words conserve spirit.
entries.logic_compare: Relative to Yinfu’s emphasis on seizing mechanism, Qingjing proves by releasing mechanism-chasing itself. Unlike elaborate neidan diagram books, this note’s logic is austere: return, don’t construct. It is closer to Laozi’s core than to later furnace taxonomy.

entries.name_han: 太上老君說常清靜經註
entries.logic_thesis: A second classical note-line proves that clarity and stillness function as a two-stroke engine: stillness gathers, clarity illumines, and their oscillation refines the heart into non-dwelling awareness. It argues against one-sided quietism and one-sided intellectual brightness. The proof is methodological: paired cultivation prevents dead emptiness and dry cleverness.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: stillness without clarity becomes dull void. 2) Premise: clarity without stillness becomes sharp scattered knowing. 3) Inference: the scripture’s binomial is a technical pair, not poetic synonym. 4) Inference: practice must alternate or co-arise gather and illuminate. 5) Inference: afflictions dissolve when seen clearly inside a stable field. 6) Conclusion: balanced qing-jing is the reliable path of mind realization for householders and adepts.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Design sessions as 2 phases: settle (jing) then open awareness without commentary (qing). 2) For metal-dry or fire-scatter chart types, weight more jing first; for water-stagnant types, introduce gentle qing earlier. 3) In decision-making, forbid analysis until body stills (pulse, breath). 4) Use walking or simple chore as ‘moving stillness’ to avoid cushion dependency. 5) Track weekly whether you leaned dull or scattered, and rebalance.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike a purely ontological reading that equates qing=jing as one essence, this line proves their complementary functions. It differs from ritual purity codes by locating purity in cognitive-affective dynamics. Against neidan’s multi-stage maps, it keeps a minimal dual method.

entries.name_han: 太上老君說常清靜經註
entries.logic_thesis: A third commentarial trajectory proves social-ethical and cosmological extension: a clear-still person becomes a non-disturbing node in family, state, and world, so personal cultivation is already political-ecological care. Turbid mind multiplies conflict cycles; constant clarity-stillness reduces collective friction. The argument binds self-cultivation to order without Confucian moralizing externalism alone.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: mind states radiate into speech, role performance, and group field. 2) Premise: the classic ties human clarity-stillness to Heaven-Earth’s calm regularity. 3) Inference: private agitation is a public risk factor. 4) Inference: governing self is the root technology of governing circumstances. 5) Inference: fate ‘softens’ around a person who stops feeding turbulence. 6) Conclusion: Qingjing practice is a civilizational micro-virtue with cosmic analogy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In relationship BaZi (spouse palace, mutual charts), treat shared turbidity as the first problem before blaming star clashes. 2) Prescribe household quiet hours and speech covenants as applied qing-jing. 3) For leaders, convert ‘stillness’ into fewer panic policy swings during clash years. 4) Use charity and fair dealing as extensions of clarity (not bribes to gods). 5) Evaluate practice by decrease of drama frequency in close networks.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from purely meditative notes, this trajectory proves outward field effects of qing-jing. It differs from Golden Register public liturgy by starting from mind rather than altar protocol. Compared with Wenchang moral biography, it is less narrative-karmic and more present-tense field hygiene.

entries.logic_thesis: The opening-covenant rite proves that large-scale retreat efficacy begins with a binding oath that aligns community will, priestly office, and Heaven’s registers before any petition is filed. Without sealed alliance (qi meng), later offerings lack jurisdictional standing. Ritual success is therefore contractual-cosmic, not merely aesthetic performance.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Golden Register retreats address high celestial ledgers for salvation and protection. 2) Premise: Heaven’s offices respond to authorized, sincere, and correctly ranked requests. 3) Inference: the opening covenant establishes legal-spiritual standing for the assembly. 4) Inference: shared oath unifies scattered private wishes into one lawful intention. 5) Inference: violation of covenant voids or weakens subsequent ritual credit. 6) Conclusion: alliance is the logical precondition of retreat power.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before a multi-day personal cultivation retreat, write and read aloud a clear covenant (scope, duration, precepts). 2) In BaZi ‘remedy’ work, refuse vague multi-wishes; form one ranked intention as your meng. 3) Include accountability (witness, journal, teacher) to mimic communal oath pressure. 4) Start programs with purification and consent, not with advanced visualizations. 5) If the covenant breaks, repair formally before restarting techniques.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike private neidan manuals that begin with body maps, this text proves public juridical entry conditions. It differs from ordinary jiao setup by focusing specifically on the opening alliance moment. Compared with Qingjing’s interior purity, here purity is sworn, collective, and procedural.

entries.logic_thesis: The jiao-establishment liturgy proves that cosmic disorder and communal risk are renegotiated through a structured banquet-audience with deities, where offerings, positions, and sequences enact a restored hierarchy. ‘She jiao’ is not entertainment; it is diplomatic protocol with Heaven. Order returns when human side correctly hosts the divine guest-order.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: imbalance in seasons, health, or polity signals broken reciprocity with higher powers. 2) Premise: deities receive hospitality and testimony in ranked ritual space. 3) Inference: correct seating, offerings, texts, and timing make the human side legible and respectful. 4) Inference: once audience is granted, confessions and petitions can be entered into the register. 5) Inference: closing and sending-off prevent lingering imbalance from incomplete diplomacy. 6) Conclusion: structured hospitality is a technology of re-harmonization.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat major luck-cycle transitions like setting a jiao: prepare space, offerings (gratitude acts), clear petition, and formal close. 2) Sequence BaZi advice as protocol: first acknowledge costs/debts, then ask, then commit conduct. 3) Use seasonal festivals as natural jiao nodes rather than random crisis only. 4) Avoid ‘buy luck’ transactions without reciprocal virtue—protocol without sincerity fails. 5) After any big ritual or life move, perform a conscious send-off (thanksgiving, cleanup, rest).
entries.logic_compare: Where the Opening Covenant establishes standing, She Jiao proves the main diplomatic audience itself. It differs from personal stillness practice by being overtly hierarchical and material (altar, offerings). Unlike narrative miracle tales, its proof is procedural correctness under Golden Register rank.

entries.name_han: 洞玄靈寶玉籙簡文三元威儀自然真經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that true ritual authority is ‘natural demeanor’ (ziran weiyi): bodily bearing, sequence, and script that spontaneously mirror the Three Primes’ cosmic hierarchy. Lingbao salvation technology works when human movement becomes isomorphic with heaven’s own order. Form is not empty shell; form is condensed cosmos.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the Three Primes structure time, judgment, and salvation registers. 2) Premise: Lingbao rites claim to operate those registers for universal deliverance. 3) Inference: without precise natural deportment, the human body fails to match the register’s ‘interface.’ 4) Inference: written jade instructions fix the interface so transmission does not drift. 5) Inference: ‘natural’ means according to Dao’s order, not casual improvisation. 6) Conclusion: perfected etiquette is soteriological engineering.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Standardize your reading posture, breath, and desk layout as ‘weiyi’ for every BaZi consultation—form stabilizes mind. 2) Learn one complete ceremonial sequence in life (tea, bow, offering) to train body as orderly instrument. 3) Align annual three-yuan / three-prime seasonal audits with confession and reset. 4) Prefer transmitted forms over DIY occult mashups when stakes are high. 5) Correct sloppy daily etiquette (doors, greetings, meals) as micro-Lingbao training.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from Golden Register’s specific retreat and jiao dossiers, this text proves the general principle that natural cosmic etiquette is itself the true scripture. It differs from neidan diagrams by externalizing order into visible deportment. Compared with Qingjing, it externalizes purity into choreography rather than only mind.

entries.logic_thesis: Collected commentary on the Jade Emperor scripture proves that ultimate moral-salvific sovereignty is centralized in a celestial imperial court whose decrees organize all lesser offices, gods, and human fates. Multi-note collation shows the Huangjing as constitution of the sacred empire rather than a private meditation pamphlet. The argument: loyalty, repentance, and recitation plug the person into the highest lawful source of pardon and protection.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: the Jade Emperor stands at the apex of the popular-Daoist celestial bureaucracy. 2) Premise: the root scripture narrates and enacts that sovereignty. 3) Inference: commentaries from multiple hands recover doctrinal, ritual, and ethical layers of that constitution. 4) Inference: human misfortune is often a lower-office problem that still answers to highest court. 5) Inference: sincere recitation is a petition technology under imperial law, not magic independence. 6) Conclusion: aligning with the August Writ reorders subordinate fate mechanisms.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When charts show stacked authority stars or severe official-kill patterns, interpret through ‘court hierarchy’: which level of life law is active? 2) Use confession + high-level dedication (service, honesty under power) as parallel to Huangjing repentance. 3) For protection cases, combine practical legal/ethical cleanup with spiritual petition—same as addressing the apex court after fixing lower faults. 4) Study one chapter with multiple notes to avoid single-sect slogans. 5) Cultivate respectful speech about rulers, teachers, and parents as training in celestial hierarchy literacy.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Dipper Benming texts that emphasize stellar natal officers, Huangjing jizhu centers apex imperial sovereignty. It differs from Yinfu’s secret mechanism by stressing public sacred law and pardon. Relative to local earth-god or Taishan cults, it argues top-down constitutional order.

entries.name_han: 元始天尊說東嶽化身濟生度死拔罪解冤保命玄範誥呪妙經
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that life, death, sin, grievance, and lifespan fall under East Peak (Taishan) jurisdiction, and that Yuanshi’s revealed forms, proclamations, and spells authorize lawful intervention in that underworld-administrative complex. Salvation is not vague compassion only; it is procedural release across specific case types (guilt, feud, premature death). Proof object: specialized eschatological bureaucracy can be petitioned through revealed templates.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: East Peak administers registers of the dead and many living debts. 2) Premise: grievances and sins bind lifespan and rebirth trajectories. 3) Inference: without authority from a higher revealer (Yuanshi), local petition may lack force. 4) Inference: categorized aims (ji sheng, du si, ba zui, jie yuan, bao ming) require matching formulaic speech-acts. 5) Inference: incarnation language (‘huashen’) shows the Peak’s power can take accessible forms for aid. 6) Conclusion: structured gao-zhou practice is legal medicine for fate-knots of guilt and feud.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Separate client problems into the text’s categories: living crisis, death rites, guilt, interpersonal curse-like feud, pure longevity. 2) For chart patterns of empty luck + chronic conflict, investigate unresolved grievances (family, business) as jie-yuan work. 3) Combine apology/restitution in the human world with any liturgical petition—bureaucracy checks both. 4) Use memorial days and Qingming-type nodes as natural East Peak calendrical openings. 5) Avoid generic ‘bless me’ requests; file the correct case type.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Qingjing’s mind purification or Yinfu’s strategy, this text proves underworld-administrative soteriology. It differs from Wenchang’s literary-moral curriculum by focusing death, sin, and feud ledgers. Relative to Golden Register high retreats, it is more specialized to Taishan’s docket.

entries.logic_thesis: Gan Bao’s collection proves the reality and moral intelligibility of the spirit world by cumulative case evidence: anomalies, ghosts, and divine responses recur with pattern under Heaven’s order. The logic is proto-empirical and historiographic rather than purely revelatory: many witnessed irregularities jointly refute a closed material cosmos. Spirits enforce ethics and answer sincerity across scattered locales.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: singular marvels can be dismissed as error or fraud. 2) Premise: carefully recorded multi-region cases show repeated structure (wrongdoing punished, virtue answered, boundaries between living/dead). 3) Inference: the numinous is a stable layer of the world, not random noise. 4) Inference: human virtue and vice have cross-realm consequences. 5) Inference: historiography of anomalies is a legitimate knowing method for Dao-adjacent culture. 6) Conclusion: moral-cosmic order includes spirit agency as a fact to live with.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In counseling, treat ‘weird’ life strings as data requiring pattern-finding, not automatic superstition or automatic denial. 2) Build a personal case log of timing + event + ethical context analogous to Soushen method. 3) Use stories pedagogically to teach consequences without fabricating guarantees. 4) When BaZi coincides with classic ghost-feud motifs (sudden night illness, repeated similar accidents), add grievance-audit before more metal-water technical tweaks. 5) Cultivate careful speech about the dead; the text’s world is porous.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike revealed Lingbao codes, Soushenji proves by anecdotal aggregation, not altar transmission. It differs from systematic neidan atlases by offering no cultivation ladder—only a haunted moral cosmos. Relative to imperial Huangjing theology, it is bottom-up folklore-as-evidence rather than top-down constitution.

entries.logic_thesis: The diagram corpus proves that Taiji-Hunyuan cultivation can be made cartographic: stages of yin-yang ascent/descent, three powers, and embryo-breathing are real transitions that images can fix better than prose alone. If the path is mappable, it is teachable and error-checkable. Proof object: visual isomorphism between cosmos and body process.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: mixed original qi differentiates into ordered polarities and returns. 2) Premise: the adept’s body reenacts that cosmogony in reverse and forward. 3) Inference: diagrams of three scenes, three powers, sun-moon phases, etc., are operational maps, not ornaments. 4) Inference: sequence errors in practice equal navigation errors on the map. 5) Inference: seeing the whole atlas prevents partial technique addiction. 6) Conclusion: image-logic is a valid epistemic tool for neidan transmission.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Draw your current practice location on a simple Taiji-Hunyuan sketch monthly—locate yourself. 2) Match BaZi climate (cold/hot, dry/wet) to which diagram phase needs support. 3) Use moon-phase diagrams to schedule quieter gathering vs circulating days. 4) Teach beginners with one image before vocabulary overload. 5) When stuck, return to earlier map node rather than adding exotic methods.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely textual Qingjing notes, this work proves by graphic systemization. It is more cosmogonic-overview than the more ‘pointing to mystery’ sequel, and less commercially sequential than Jinye Huandan ‘seal verification’ sets. Relative to ritual weiyi scriptures, its map is interior cosmography.

entries.logic_thesis: This ‘pointing-to-the-mysterious’ atlas proves that beyond public Taiji-Hunyuan outlines there exists a tighter esoteric indexing of key orifices, timings, and transformations that must be indicated, not merely displayed. The logic is hierarchical pedagogy: same cosmos, deeper legend keys. Diagrams here function as pointers that unlock oral or meditative secrecy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: outer diagrams can be copied without realization. 2) Premise: the mysterious hinge (xuan) is few and easy to miss. 3) Inference: a second graphic layer must mark the hinges explicitly for the prepared. 4) Inference: ‘zhi xuan’ is selective illumination, not total disclosure to the unready. 5) Inference: body-cosmos correspondences tighten around specific operations (refine form, conjoin water-fire, etc.). 6) Conclusion: true transmission is map + pointed hinge + practice confirmation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After learning a public map, isolate one hinge (e.g. true breathing pivot) for 100-day focus. 2) Keep a private legend key—personal notes of what each symbol actually did in experience. 3) Do not teach advanced pointers to those without stillness basics (Qingjing precondition). 4) Use BaZi structure to choose which hinge is safer (e.g. weak body vs strong body strategies). 5) Verify pointers by bodily signs and life stability, not by collecting more images.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with the sibling Taiji Hunyuan Tu, this text proves the necessity of esoteric pointing beyond overview cartography. It differs from Jinye’s stage-seal marketing of results by stressing mystery-hinges. Against purely philosophical Laozi notes, it remains operative and somatic.

entries.logic_thesis: The golden-liquid return-elixir ‘seal-and-verify’ diagrams prove that neidan claims must pass sequential stamps of experiential verification—each stage leaves a confirmable mark before the next is authorized. The argument is anti-fraud and anti-skipping: alchemy is a chain of evidence in the body-mind, not belief in ornate language. Golden liquid returning is a lawlike process that signs itself.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: false paths also produce visions and feelings. 2) Premise: authentic elixir stages generate ordered, cumulative signs. 3) Inference: diagrams act as seal templates against which practitioners check progress. 4) Inference: lacking a seal means the prior work is incomplete; advancing is illegitimate. 5) Inference: ‘return’ implies a closed loop back to original completeness, evidenced stepwise. 6) Conclusion: verifiable sequence is the logic of true golden elixir work.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Define 3–5 pre-agreed verification signs for your current stage (sleep quality, emotional latency, thermal balance, ethical stability). 2) Refuse stage promotion based on internet symptoms alone; require time-stamped personal seals. 3) Align intense refining with supportive luck pillars; in weak years, hold and consolidate. 4) Treat speech about attainments as a leak that breaks seals. 5) Pair any advanced claim with increased ordinary virtue—moral regression invalidates ‘proof.’
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Soushenji’s external marvel cases, yinzeng tu demands internal sequential seals. It differs from open Taiji overview maps by enforcing checkpoint logic. Relative to pure ritual pardon scriptures, it does not primarily clear external ledgers—it verifies somatic-cosmic reintegration.

entries.logic_thesis: The ‘copied diagrams of cultivation verified by experience’ prove that legitimate graphic transmission is that which has been lived through and redacted into usable schemata, not invented ornament. Experience is the editor of theory: only maps that survive practice deserve circulation. The argument is empiricist within the neidan tradition.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: many diagrams circulate without tested pedigree. 2) Premise: practitioners who complete processes can abstract what actually mattered. 3) Inference: ‘li yan’ (successive verification) filters images into a trustworthy subset. 4) Inference: copying is legitimate when it preserves verified structure, not when it multiplies novelty. 5) Inference: the resulting atlas is shorter, harder, and more operational than speculative cosmologies. 6) Conclusion: experience-audited diagrams are the rational medium of school continuity.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build your own one-page ‘verified only’ chart of methods that changed measurable life/body variables. 2) Delete or quarantine techniques that never sealed after fair trial. 3) When studying classical images, ask: what experience could have forced this drawing? 4) In BaZi advising, prefer remedies with track records in similar structures over exotic new systems. 5) End each season with a liyan review: keep, drop, rework.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from creative cosmological mural-making, this text’s authority claim is experiential audit. It differs from Jinye’s stage-seal idealism by emphasizing copied, field-tested schemata as a corpus. Against purely revealed Lingbao protocols, its proof is inductive practice history rather than celestial legislation.
